title: Graph chart of an embedded C¹ submanifold over its tangent plane (parent step 1)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M) and let p ∈ M. Then there are a continuous linear map pr : ℝ^P → ℝ^m with ‖pr‖ ≤ 1, a map G : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, a radius r > 0, an open set W ⊆ ℝ^P with p ∈ W, and a constant Λ ≥ 0 such that: G(0) = p; G is C¹ and Λ-Lipschitz on the open ball B_r(0) ⊆ ℝ^m; M ∩ W = G(B_r(0)); and for every a ∈ B_r(0), pr(G(a) − p) = a, pr∘DG(a) = id_{ℝ^m}, and tangentSpace M (G(a)) = range DG(a), where DG = fderiv ℝ G.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → p ∈ M → ∃ (pr : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), 0 < r ∧ IsOpen W ∧ p ∈ W ∧ ‖pr‖ ≤ 1 ∧ G 0 = p ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (ball 0 r) ∧ LipschitzOnWith Λ G (ball 0 r) ∧ M ∩ W = G '' ball 0 r ∧ (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) r, pr (G a - p) = a) ∧ (∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) r, pr ∘L fderiv ℝ G a = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid m)) ∧ ∀ a ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) r, tangentSpace M (G a) = Set.range (fderiv ℝ G a)
